description: The bar chart compares the average rate at which a model attends to different input segments during generation, specifically context, generated response, and other (e.g., system prompts). The horizontal axis represents the categories of input segments, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of attention. The chart is divided into two main groups, labeled "Ours" and "Standard," each with three bars representing the percentage of attention for context (blue), generated response (orange), and other (green). In the "Ours" group, the context segment receives the highest attention at 60.6%, followed by the generated response at 31.7%, and other at 7.7%. In the "Standard" group, the generated response segment receives the highest attention at 51.1%, followed by other at 25.3%, and context at 23.6%. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting or emphasis of the bars.
